features.text: Performance
ProBake® Convention Delivers Perfection on Every Rack
LG's ProBake® Convection is the gold standard in convection technology. Roast meats to perfection and evenly bake your favorite cookies and pies on every rack, every time.
Air Fry Crispy favorites to Feed a Crowd
Make fries, wings, and more. There's no pre-heating, less oil, and no extra gadgets on the counter.
Seal in Restaurant-Quality Results with Air Sous Vide
Using low oven temperatures and air flow around vacuum sealed ingredients, Air Sous Vide consistently delivers tender and juicy meats, fish and poultry that are cooked to perfection.
Turn up the Heat Quickly with a 22K BTU Dual Burn
Get LG's Fastest Boiling Burner and Get Dinner Done With the UltraHeat™ 22k BTU dual power burner, rapidly heat to boil quickly or turn down to simmer.
Design
A Sleek, Built-in look
The slide-in design places the controls up front for a premium, built-in look that lets the beauty of your custom backsplash and countertops show through.
Backlit SmoothTouch® Glass Controls Contorls

The intuitive SmoothTouch® glass controls deliver sleek style and easy operation, with just a touch of your finger. Plus, the smooth surface easily wipes clean for a design that is as practical as it is stylish.
Brilliant Blue Interior
An outstanding oven should meet your needs and look beautiful doing it. Our blue, porcelain-enamel interior provides a distinctive look while offering easy visibility inside the oven.
PrintProof® Stainless Steel finish

Now you can have all of the things you love about stainless, without the need for special cleaners or constant attention. LG’s PrintProof® fingerprint and smudge resistant finish easily wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth for a distinctive kitchen that handles real-life in style.
Convenience
A Smarter home starts with the LG ThinQ® app

Use the ThinQ® app to remotely start/stop the oven, set timers, and check on your appliance from anywhere. Simply speak to control your appliance with Alexa or Google Assistant. Plus, with scan-to-cook technology and LG Smart Cooking Partners, you can send cooking instructions straight to your oven by simply scanning the barcode on the package of ready-made meals, or by selecting one of the thousands of recipes in the app.
ThinQ care helps keep your appliance running smoothly
Discover ThinQ Care in the ThinQ® app and get proactive usage, maintenance and diagnostic alerts on your smartphone to help keep your LG smart appliances running smoothly.
Knock twice to see inside with InstaView®
Check on food in an instant. Simply knock twice on the InstaView® window to turn on the oven light without letting heat escape.
Keep your oven clean without Elbow Grease
Simply spray the oven interior with water, press the EasyClean® button, and let the oven do the work in just 10 minutes—without chemicals or high-heat. Then, easily wipe away the leftover residue.
